label: Rhode Island Wing
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered wing patch width 3.25 in (as the other wing emblems); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

ground_removed.flood: 4-neighbour flood from the picture's edge over pixels within 6 levels of the ground colour

band.rule: alpha from the pixel colour's place between the ground colour and the outline's solid colour, colour taken from the outline

provenance: Official digital artwork of Rhode Island Wing, published by CAP national Marketing & Communication (MAC) team: the Brand Tools app linked from the CAP Brand Portal (brand.gocivilairpatrol.com); hosted at cap-brand-tools.netlify.app, not a cap.gov domain (page https://cap-brand-tools.netlify.app/logo-generator/; file address https://cap-brand-tools.netlify.app/logo-generator/wing/wing__riemblem.png); fetched 2026-11-10 and kept in assets/refs/patches-official/ner_wing_ri/. Shipped as given on 2026-11-10: the PNG byte for byte; no resampling, no retouching, no colour change. It replaces the redraw that stood under this asset id. On 2026-11-12, at the owner's request, the ground that came around the emblem (opaque white; 20838 px, found by a flood from the picture's edge) was made clear, and the 2230 px where the outline had been blended into it (up to 3 px deep) were given their alpha from where their colour lies between the ground colour and the outline's own solid colour (#000067) and took that colour, and the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (300 x 300 px to 297 x 296 px; the result is 8-bit RGBA); no resampling, no redrawing, no other colour change.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The ground around the emblem was made clear on 2026-11-12 (the owner: background removed from the patches), nothing else was changed.
